sources.title: A survey on audio-visual large language models - ScienceDirect
sources.snippet: In particular, this survey presents a comprehensive overview of AV-LLMs by systematically categorizing model architectures, training objectives, and available datasets. We identify current methodological trends, limitations, and downstream applications, including audio and video captioning, multimodal conversational AI, and cross-modal retrieval.

sources.title: From Vision to Audio and Beyond: A Unified Model for Audio-Visual ...
sources.snippet: Since VAB is a unified model, its backbone can be fine-tuned for various audio-visual downstream tasks. Our experiments showcase the efficiency of VAB in producing high-quality audio from video, and its capability to acquire semantic audio-visual features, leading to competitive results in audio-visual retrieval and classification.
